benchmark_name: CQWM v0.3: Zero-Fit Intracellular Hepatocyte/Enterocyte Depot Washout Closure Across 3 Human Cohorts (N=40; PMID 38393578, 17635500, 21937987) & Live 8-Qubit Multi-Slot Quantum Comb + ASPS on Quantinuum Nexus Helios-1E-lite

epistemic_demarcation.clinical_claim_boundary: Strictly non-commercial scientific research shadow-mode validation under NHS DCB0129/DCB0160; Helios-1E-lite is a classical stabilized-noise cloud emulator (0 physical QPU shots), the 8-qubit Comb sits below the 19-qubit (n_B=14) 1 TiB classical Liouvillian crossover, and all 6 clinical hazards (including H-LTC-02 pending prospective NHS patient-level EHR/PK validation) remain OPEN.

literature_priors.citation: Keemink J, Augustijns P, Annaert P. J Pharm Sci. 2015;104(7):2378-2387.
literature_priors.parameter_extracted: Intact primary human hepatocyte unbound intracellular accumulation ratio Kp,uu,hep = 1.4 +/- 0.2 (Cu,cell = 8 +/- 1 nM at 0.5 uM extracellular ritonavir) with strong intracellular phospholipid/lysosomal binding (fu,cell << fu,plasma).

literature_priors.citation: Kirby BJ, Collier AC, Kharasch ED, Whittington D, Thummel KE, Unadkat JD. Drug Metab Dispos. 2011;39(6):1070-1078.
literature_priors.parameter_extracted: Sandwich-cultured human hepatocyte CYP3A4 inactivation + induction and nonlinear CYP3A4 autoinhibition of ritonavir disposition predicting human oral/IV midazolam DDIs.

literature_priors.citation: Dixit V, Hariparsad N, Li F, Desai P, Thummel KE, Unadkat JD. Drug Metab Dispos. 2007;35(10):1853-1859.
literature_priors.parameter_extracted: Primary human hepatocyte PXR-mediated transcriptional induction of CYP3A4 mRNA and protein alongside concurrent enzymatic CYP3A4 suppression by ritonavir.

literature_priors.citation: Rohr BS, Krohmer E, Foerster KI, et al. Clin Pharmacokinet. 2024;63(4):505-517.
literature_priors.parameter_extracted: Out-of-sample Cohort 1 benchmark (N=8 healthy humans, EudraCT 2021-006643-39): 5-day ritonavir 100 mg BID + oral microdose midazolam across Baseline, Days 1-5, Day 7 (+48h, plasma < LLOQ), and Day 9 (+96h).

literature_priors.citation: Quinney SK, Haehner BD, Rhoades MB, Lin Z, Gorski JC, Hall SD. Br J Clin Pharmacol. 2008;65(1):98-109.
literature_priors.parameter_extracted: Out-of-sample Cohort 2 benchmark (N=16 elderly humans aged 65-75 y): 7-day clarithromycin 500 mg BID + simultaneous IV midazolam (AUCR = 3.20x, FH: 0.73->0.91) and oral 15N3-midazolam (AUCR = 8.00x, FG: 0.47->0.79).

literature_priors.citation: Quinney SK, Zhang X, Lucksiri A, Gorski JC, Li L, Hall SD. Drug Metab Dispos. 2010;38(2):241-248.
literature_priors.parameter_extracted: Paired semi-PBPK clarithromycin CYP3A4 MBI & nonlinear autoinhibition parameters (KI = 5.3 uM, kinact_hep = 0.4 h^-1, kinact_gut = 4.0 h^-1).

literature_priors.citation: Katzenmaier S, Markert C, Riedel KD, Burhenne J, Haefeli WE, Mikus G. Clin Pharmacol Ther. 2011;90(5):666-673.
literature_priors.parameter_extracted: Out-of-sample Cohort 3 specificity benchmark (N=16 randomized healthy humans): 9-day reversible voriconazole (peak MDZ CL = 10.6% baseline [AUCR 9.43x], post-washout t_1/2 = 24 h) vs irreversible ritonavir 300 mg BID (peak MDZ CL = 8.4% baseline [AUCR 11.90x], still strongly inhibited 3 days post-discontinuation).

trial_metadata.perpetrator_regimen: Oral ritonavir 100 mg twice daily on Days 1-5 (discontinued after Day 5)
trial_metadata.probe_substrate: Oral microdosed midazolam 25 ug (CYP3A4 index substrate)

trial_metadata.perpetrator_regimen: Oral clarithromycin 500 mg twice daily for 7 days
trial_metadata.probe_substrate: Simultaneous IV midazolam (0.05 mg/kg) + oral 15N3-midazolam (3.5 mg) at baseline and 2 h after final clarithromycin dose

trial_metadata.arms: Randomized N=8 oral voriconazole (reversible CYP3A inhibitor, 9 days) vs N=8 oral ritonavir 300 mg BID (irreversible MBI + depot, 9 days), with 3 mg oral midazolam solution probed through Day 12 (+72h post-discontinuation)
trial_metadata.ritonavir_day12_plus72h_qualitative: Strong CYP3A inhibition persisted 3 days (+72h, Day 12) after discontinuation

candidate_policies.description: Unmodified co-administration during Days 1-5 oral ritonavir 100 mg BID
Naive restart on Day 7 (+48h post-washout, plasma RTV < LLOQ at 1.53 ng/mL, Cu,hep = 3.02 nM)
Early restart on Day 9 (+96h post-washout; AUCR 2.26x still slightly exceeds 2.0x ceiling)
Pharmacist SMR depot-aware hold through Day 10 (+120h post-washout) after intracellular depot clearance
